technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions with bullish micro-structure (RSI9, stoch, three white soldiers) conflict with weak intermediate trend structure (no MA crosses, below 200-day) and low ADX; moderate risk/reward for swing entry with elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: CSGP shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 60 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (359.36) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 60 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term overbought RSI/stoch with three white soldiers and donchian breakout offer micro-structure bullish setup in extreme fear regime (11/100 contrarian opportunity).
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 359.36, negative yield curve, high credit spreads), price below both 200-day MAs, weak ADX (23.88), no MA bullish crosses, and zero fundamental/insider support create severe headwinds that overwhelm short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term overbought technicals (RSI9, stoch, three white soldiers) offer micro-structure appeal in extreme fear regime; however, macro crisis conditions, price below 200-day MAs, weak trend structure, and zero fundamental support create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (359.36) combined with negative yield curve and high credit spreads creates systemic drawdown risk that will likely overwhelm any swing trade gains; earnings in 60 days adds event uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought conditions insufficient to overcome macro headwinds and fundamental weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 21 positions in Real Estate sector; adding CSGP increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify sector overweight.
